description.value: A hike-in backcountry campground beside an alpine lake in Mount Revelstoke National Park; reservable but requires a multi-hour trail approach with no vehicle or loaded-bike access to the lakeshore.

address.value: Eva Lake, Columbia-Shuswap, BC V0E 2S0, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Eva Lake is explicitly described on the Parks Canada website as a 'Backcountry Campground' in Mount Revelstoke National Park with only 4 sites (OSM capacity tag). The detailed amenity list on the page (flush toilets, showers, electricity, etc.) belongs to Snowforest Campground, not Eva Lake. As a backcountry site, Eva Lake requires hiking to access and is not reachable by bicycle, making it unsuitable for a cycling tourism directory.
concerns: Backcountry campground not accessible by bicycle - hiking access only
All detailed amenities listed on the camping page belong to Snowforest Campground, not Eva Lake
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Eva Lake is a backcountry campground accessible only by hiking trail, not reachable by bicycle. It has only 4 sites and no road access. Not relevant to touring cyclists. Snowforest Campground (the frontcountry option, 2km by bike from Revelstoke) would be the appropriate listing for this park.
enrichment_extras.notes: Consider adding Snowforest Campground instead - it is explicitly described as '2km north by bike or on foot' from downtown Revelstoke and has full amenities including showers, electricity, potable water, food lockers, and kitchen shelter.
